title: newState wrong after maxChanges truncation
description: After truncation in ChatContact/changes, newState is set to result.new_state (the current store state) rather than the state at the last returned change. A client that receives a truncated response with hasMoreChanges=true uses newState as sinceState on the next call, which will land past the truncated changes — they are silently dropped and never delivered. RFC 8620 §5.6 requires newState to be the state of the last change returned so the client can page forward correctly.
